_consumed_by: configs/personas.json (per-persona signal_weights override the defaults here)
_comment: Reference catalog of canonical signal valences. Per-persona weights live in personas.json.
_runtime_pool_comment: _runtime_pool lists signals the stress_test_runner currently draws. Items in 'positive'/'negative' but absent from _runtime_pool (e.g. gift, withdrawal, betrayal) are reserved for future scenario expansion.
